external_reverse_main_symbol_inventory.scan_scope_and_rules: Exhaustive AST-based scan of all Python files in services/, tests/, and scripts/ excluding .venv, lean/, and .git. Uses context-aware resolution: modules explicitly named 'bff.main', 'services.control-plane.bff.main', 'services.control_plane.bff.main', relative imports inside services/control-plane/bff/, and bare 'main' imports where the caller is located within services/control-plane/bff/ or manipulates sys.path to point to BFF.
